mapping.draft_py:
# Serra's Guardian (M20). "Other creatures you control have vigilance."
# Shape: B4-grant-kw-static-you (Ajani, the Greathearted) with the "other" FNot(IS_SOURCE) part
# that B4-modify-pt-other-dogs (Pack Leader) uses.
other_vigilance = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
        'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.VIGILANCE),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QUnbounded(),
            mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [other_vigilance, *compiled]
